name: 19463-highqpsmixed-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process engine.
load_profile: constant (open loop), rate = 100 requests/s, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, warmup the first 30% by completion. The rate is above what this engine sustains on this shape, so the admitted population grows for as long as arrivals continue.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, streaming, text only: exactly 600 prompt tokens and exactly 125 output tokens (min = max on both), greedy, ignore_eos, no images.
purpose: A vision-capable 3B assistant serving text-only single-turn chat, 100 requests per second of uniform short prompts, one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line at commit 981eeca41aed8202074f36baa1e46eb9c2c82b16 (v0.9.1-229).
# Nothing here is tuned and there is no tunable.yaml. Interpreter and hardware are in env.yaml.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct

max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
block-size: 16

# LOAD-BEARING: prefix caching is ON by default in this engine's V1 path, and guidellm's synthetic
# prompts share a generated preamble, so leaving it on would serve much of every 600-token prefill
# from cache and change the request shape.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# At this arrival rate a per-request log line is itself a large, variable host cost.
disable-log-requests: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# The attention backend is deliberately unpinned; read it off the startup log rather than assuming.
